content: Wisi bi bu du, bu rɑ mɔru suresiewɑ, ɑdɑmɑ ɡɑri ɡerubu kɑ dɑm biyɑ bu rɑ mɔru seesie.
Bwisiɡiin ɡɑri yi rɑ de tɔnu u yɛ̃ru kɑsu, ɑdɑmɑ ɡɑri bɔkɔn nɔɔ, wiirɑ ɡɑriyɑ ɡɑ rɑ n sɑɑrimɔ.
Yinni Gusunɔn nɔni wɑ̃ɑwɑ yɑm kpuro. Yi tɔn kɔ̃sobu kɑ ɡemɡibu mɛɛrɑ.
Gɑri yi yi nukuru yɛmiɑsiɑmɔ yiyɑ yi rɑ kɑ wɑ̃ɑru nɛ, ɑdɑmɑ ɡɑri kɑm yi rɑ tɔnun ɡɔ̃ru sɑnkuwɑ.
Wi u rɑ win bɑɑbɑn sɔ̃ɔsiru ɑtɑfiiru ko, ɡɑri bɔkɔwɑ, ɑdɑmɑ wi u rɑ ɡerusibu wure, win bwisi koo sɔ̃ɔsirɑ.
Gemɡiin yɛnuɔrɑ ɑrumɑni bɑkɑ wɑ̃ɑ, ɑdɑmɑ ye tɔn kɔ̃sobɑ mɛnnɑmɔ, wɑhɑlɑwɑ yɑ rɑ kɑ nɛ.
Bwisiɡibun nɔɔwɑ ɡɑ rɑ n yɛ̃ru kpɑrɑmɔ, ɑdɑmɑ bwisi sɑriruɡibun ɡɔ̃ru ɡɑ ǹ sɑ̃ɑ mɛ.
Yinni Gusunɔ u ku rɑ tɔn kɔ̃sobun yɑ̃kuru wɑɑbu kɑ̃, ɑdɑmɑ ɡemɡibun kɑnɑru tɑ rɑ nùn wɛ̃re.
Yinni Gusunɔ u tɔn kɔ̃sobun swɑɑ tusɑ, ɑdɑmɑ be bɑ ɡeɑ mɔ̀, beyɑ u kĩ.
Wi u swɑɑ ɡeɑ deri, bɑ koo yɛ̃ro sɛɛyɑsiɑwɑ ɡem ɡem. Wi u mɑɑ sɛɛyɑsiɑbu yinɑ, u koo ɡbiwɑ.
Yinni Gusunɔ u yɛ̃ ye yɑ koorɑmɔ ɡɔribun wɑ̃ɑ yerɔ. Kɑɑ sere ɡere tɔnun ɡɔ̃ruɔ?
Wi u tii sue, u ku rɑ kɑ̃ bu nùn ɡerusi. U ku rɑ mɑɑ kɑ̃ bwisiɡibu bu nùn bwisi kɛ̃.
Nuku dobɑ bu rɑ wuswɑɑ dɛɛrɑsie, ɑdɑmɑ nuku sɑnkirɑru tɑ rɑ wuswɑɑ burisinɛwɑ.
Wi u bwisi mɔ, u rɑ yɛ̃ru kɑsuwɑ, ɑdɑmɑ ɡɑri bɔkɔ u rɑ n buriwɑ win ɡɑri bɑkɑru sɔɔ.
Wɔnwɔndo u rɑ n wɑ̃ɑwɑ wɑhɑlɑ sɔɔ bɑɑdommɑ, ɑdɑmɑ doo nɔɔruɡii, u rɑ n tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑru mɔ̀wɑ sɑɑ bɑɑyere.
N burɑm bo ɑ n sɑ̃ɑ sɑ̃ɑro, kpɑ ɑ n Yinni Gusunɔ nɑsie, n kere ɑ n dukiɑ mɔ kpɑ ɑ n wurure.
N sɑnɔ bo ɑ di kɑ kpee wurusu yɛnu mi kĩrɑ wɑ̃ɑ, n kere ɑ di kɑ yɑɑ ɡumɡiɑ yɛnu ɡèn mi tusirɑ wɑ̃ɑ.
Wi u mɔru mɔ, u rɑ sɑnnɔsu seeyewɑ, ɑdɑmɑ wi u suuru mɔ u rɑ su kpeesiewɑ.
Yikuron swɑɑ yɑ rɑ n sɑ̃ki yibɑwɑ. Wi u ɡem swĩiɡiɑ kpɑ yɑ n dɛɛre.
Bii bwisiɡiiwɑ u rɑ de win tundon nukurɑ n do, ɑdɑmɑ bii ɡɑri bɔkɔ u rɑ win mɛro ɡɛmwɑ.
Gɑri bɑkɑ kookoosu su rɑ ɡɑri bɔkɔ dorewɑ, ɑdɑmɑ wi u bwisi mɔ, dɑɑ ɡeɑ u rɑ ko.
Wi u ku rɑ bwisi bikie win himbɑn sɔ̃, yɑ ku rɑ koore, ɑdɑmɑ wi u bwisi kɛ̃ɔbu mɔ, win himbɑ yɑ rɑ koorewɑ.
Wi u ɡɑri wisibu tubɑ sɑɑ ye n weenɛ, u rɑ n nuku dobu mɔwɑ.
Wi u bwisi mɔ, u rɑ wɑ̃ɑrun swɑɑ swĩiwɑ, kpɑ u swɑɑ deri ye yɑ dɔɔ ɡɔɔwɔ.
Yinni Gusunɔ u rɑ tii suon diru surewɑ, ɑdɑmɑ u ku rɑ de bu ɡɔminin tem kɔɔrɔ mure.
Yinni Gusunɔ u bwisi kɔ̃si tusɑ, ɑdɑmɑ ɡɑri yi yi kĩru sɔ̃ɔsimɔ, yiyɑ yi rɑ nùn dore.
Wi u rɑ ɡobi kɑsu kɑ swɑɑ kɔ̃sɑ, u win yɛnu wɑhɑlɑ dokemɔwɑ, ɑdɑmɑ wi u nɔm birɑn kɛ̃nu tusɑ, u ko n wɑ̃ɑwɑ.
Gemɡii u rɑ bwisikuwɑ u sere wisi, ɑdɑmɑ ɡɑri kɔ̃siyɑ tɔn kɔ̃so u rɑ n sɑɑrimɔ.
Yinni Gusunɔ u ku rɑ tɔn kɔ̃son kɑnɑru lɑɑkɑri ko, ɑdɑmɑ u rɑ ɡemɡiin kɑnɑru nɔ.
À n tɔnu mɛɛrɑ kɑ kĩru, u ko n nuku dobu mɔ. À n mɑɑ tɔnu lɑbɑɑri dorɑ sɔ̃ɔwɑ, yɑ rɑ nùn dɑm kɛ̃.
Wi u ɡerusibu wurɑ bi bu koo nùn fɑɑbɑ ko, u ko n wɑ̃ɑwɑ bwisiɡibun wuurɔ.
Wi u sɔ̃ɔsiru yinɑ, u tii mɛɛrɑ mɔ̀wɑ, ɑdɑmɑ wi u wurɑ bɑ nùn ɡerusi, u koo bwisi wɑ.
À n kĩ ɑ bwisi ko, ɑ de ɑ ɡinɑ Gusunɔ nɑsiɑ. À n kĩ ɑ bɛɛrɛ wɑ, ɑ de ɑ ɡinɑ tii kɑwɑ.
A Yinni Gusunɔ yɑɑyo
bɑɑdommɑ wunɛn wɑ̃ɑru sɔɔ
